text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas!!
choice_data_list: Whoa, you scared the heck out of me!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Here, take this!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting for you!!

"...The usual hurricane has passed.
Calming myself down, I open the card that was handed to me—"

I made my way to the church at the appointed time.
Apprehensively, I opened the door――

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —Merry Christmas, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome to my special recital!
The performer is me, and you're my only audience."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: To express all my gratitude up to this day, tonight I shall gift you a majestic melody.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Take my hand!
I'll guide you to the best seat in the house!
Bewildered by Epiphaneia's unusual atmosphere, I sat in the seat she guided me to. Where she headed next was—

I've seen her play the piano before...
but the pipe organ is an entirely different beast.
While I was still marveling that she could play this too—

"Is it classical music? With each deft movement
of Epiphaneia's limbs, every single note materialized
into three dimensions... overwhelming my entire body."

"A powerful resonance echoes throughout the church.
The sound turns into a meteor shower, making both heart and body tremble—"
This performance is... Epiphaneia's running, and her very way of being. With incredible explosive power, it captivates the hearts of all who watch, and before you know it—
choice_data_list: (I feel drawn... into her gravitational pull.)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much for listening!

I clapped with all my heart.
It was such a deeply moving performance...
it felt almost wasteful to keep it all to myself.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "...Your eyes are watering. You were really moved, weren't you!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I worked hard in practice!
choice_data_list: Wait, all that practice was... for this?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I messed around with it when I was a kid,
but that was my first time playing seriously!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
After training,
I was secretly taking lessons!
Hehehe, you didn't notice, did ya!
choice_data_list: Why'd you do so much for me...?
Why did you do so much for me...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: For this year's Christmas present, I absolutely wanted to get you something that would make your heart tremble!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: And that reminded me! Of how enraptured you looked when I was playing the piano!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Then that made me want to let them hear
an even more amazing performance!
It was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, I can feel it. Your heart is truly looking at me. So—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'll take full responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —...Follow me!
When I stepped out onto the church balcony, the sky had completely darkened before I realized it.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —I chose you as my Trainer because the 'voice of destiny' pushed me forward.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“Still, in reality...
the voice was my own. Which means....”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Destiny brought us together—
and I fell in love with you at first sight.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
What if we'd never met?
I definitely would have gone searching for you.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
What if I hadn't fallen in love at first sight?
I would have gotten to know you, and fallen in love with you all the same.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I absolutely need you.
—As a partner to fulfill our dreams together."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And you, too...
Right now, you're feeling destiny with me.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Entrust your entire career as a trainer—
your whole life—to me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I want to see every single sight that lies at the end of the path we run together with you.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'll share all my joy with you.
And all your sorrows, I'll brush them completely away!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I swear I will definitely make you happy.
So—keep your eyes only on me!"

Her earnestness came through loud and clear.
To be thought of so highly is the greatest honor a Trainer could ask for. However...
choice_data_list: Thank you, Epi. I appreciate the thought.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Then...!
choice_data_list: Still, I can't entrust my entire career as a Trainer to it.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
choice_data_list: The reverse doesn't hold true, you know.

text_block_list.text:
A trainer is entrusted with an Umamusume's athletic career.
That responsibility can only be borne as an instructor, and in this sense, it is not a bidirectional relationship.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
choice_data_list: Still, I can make you a promise.
Still, I can promise you this.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
!!
What kind of promise is that!?
choice_data_list: I'll see your destiny through to the very end!
I'll see your destiny through to the very end!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
Make sure you watch me until the very end, okay?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —It's a promise!

On the way back to the academy
with Epiphaneia after she had changed—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah!!
There's something past those trees!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny says so too!
Let's go, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Because we made a promise!
That you'd watch over me until the very end!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Right? All right, let's go!!

And so, Christmas night
passed in quite a rowdy fashion...

"—Afterward, since Epiphaneia mentioned being hungry...
I looked for a restaurant to treat her as thanks for the performance."

Since it was Christmas, though, we couldn't get any last-minute reservations...
So we ended up having dinner at the only hotel that would take us.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ta-da!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: How's that, cute, right?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it looks great on you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right!
For now, this should do.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'm reflected in your eyes.
And that's something that will never change.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No!
It has only deepened my resolve!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, let's go have dinner!
—I'm gonna eat a ton!!"

Epiphaneia smiles brightly.
And so, Christmas night grew late,
filled with fun and merriment...
